rules: Do not replace accepted hardware merely because historical source is inconvenient.
Persist source, commands, results, report and manifest for every experiment.
Do not label model/process data as fabricated measurement.
Persistent NVM is a sparse consolidation layer, not a mirror of live adaptive roles.
Coherent quantum memory is not part of the current cheap GVS fabric.
Use stochastic exploration only where measured benefit repays it; no quantum source is required.
Keep Local Venule -> Charge Artery -> regional reservoir -> battery/collector recovery hierarchy.
Local Contradiction Restart may disturb only the unresolved contradiction neighborhood; solved Binding/Relation state is preserved.
Regional resource pressure may control extra settling and reserve recruitment but may not veto a mature local contradiction restart.
Population Confidence remains the authority for robust answers; restart/reseed mechanisms never authorize an answer.
MOS transistors are prohibited inside the v14G/v14H semantic and reasoning core candidate; v14E CMOS remains reference evidence only.
Prefer sparse learned two-terminal links over dense all-to-all connectivity unless measured accuracy requires density.
Prefer sparse restoration junctions over one active exotic device per semantic cell.
Do not claim a two-terminal device is cheaper than CMOS until area, process steps, programming overhead, yield and energy are measured or credibly bounded.
Goal Echo remains part of the reasoning hypothesis: forward prompt evidence and reciprocal goal compatibility must be compared against forward-only controls.
CRRO is currently accepted only for exact modular addition in Z_420; do not call it general arithmetic.
Need-Triggered Transformation Cells select reusable transformations from current unmet state; they are not a hidden program counter.
Multiplication and factorization remain unresolved until a structural operator passes unseen-pair, variation, confidence and hardware-cost tests.
